title: After months of trial & error, I finally shipped my puzzle game Airplane Jam on Google Play!
author: Loud-Plate6131
selftext:
Just pushed my first mobile game live on the Play Store. It's an airport traffic and color-sorting puzzle where you have to clear passengers and manage the runway before things back up.

Doing this solo was a grind, mostly trying to keep the grid logic from breaking and making sure the UI didn't look stretched on different phones. I relied pretty heavily on AI to help untangle state bugs and prototype the level mechanics without spending weeks stuck on boilerplate code.

If anyone wants to try it out and let me know if the early levels feel too slow or if the UI makes sense, I'd really appreciate it: [Google Play Store Link](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codeccraft.airplanejam&pli=1)
